title: The Faithful Bridge
author: Lior Nakamura
blurb: Felix Ishikawa, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
